versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
A clockwork cuckoo tribe whose fights keep time: every third attack strikes the hour and sets off its effects.
Eggs laid in enemy units hatch into Chicks that attack from inside the enemy's line, while dormice sleep safe until their hour.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Wrote clear rules for Chicks and sleep: a Chick is your awake unit wherever it stands, attacks after your other units, and 'In the nest' now reads plainly.
Egg-Painter also turns a lost Egg into Brood once a fight, so the feel-bad case becomes growth.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
